sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Portfolio Overview provides a comprehensive view of all projects and services across the organization. It has three tabs: Dashboard, Intake Queue, and Approvals. Controllers and executives use this module to monitor portfolio health, review new submissions, and approve change requests.

sections.title: Dashboard Tab
sections.body: The Dashboard shows a KPI summary row at the top (total budget, YTD spend, forecast-at-completion, variance, CapEx/OpEx split, Run/Change ratio), followed by a filter bar and the portfolio tree table. The tree is expandable: LoB → Program → Project/Service. Each row shows RAG status, budget figures, and timeline. Click any project row to open a summary panel on the right.

sections.title: Portfolio Tree Navigation
sections.body: Expand LoB rows to see programs and projects underneath. Aggregate values (budget, variance) roll up at each level. Use the filter bar to narrow by LoB, status, RAG color, cost center, or type (project vs service). Sort by any column header.

sections.title: Summary Panel
sections.body: Clicking a project opens a slide-in panel on the right showing RAG status, budget snapshot (baseline/forecast/actuals), timeline bar, last CR summary, and a forecast trend sparkline. Use the 'Open in Workbench' button to navigate to the full project detail in the Project Workbench module.

sections.title: Charts
sections.body: Three charts complement the table: Budget by LoB (stacked bar), Forecast Trajectory (line chart showing how total forecast shifted over time), and RAG Distribution (donut chart). These update based on active filters.

sections.title: Intake Queue Tab
sections.body:
Shows pending new project submissions and projects with requested changes. Each row displays the project name, submitter, LoB, estimated budget, timeline, submission date, and current status (pending_approval, changes_requested).

**Controller actions:** Click a row to review the full estimation. Controllers can:
- **Approve** — project becomes active with the estimation locked in as baseline
- **Reject** — project is returned to draft
- **Request Changes** — opens an editable forecast grid where the controller can modify specific cells (hours, amounts), add feedback text, and send back to the Project Lead with proposed changes

**Diff View:** When a controller has requested changes, clicking 'Open Full Detail' shows a side-by-side diff comparing the original submission against the controller's proposed changes. Changed cells are highlighted (green for reductions, red for increases). A KPI strip shows Original Plan, Proposed Changes, and Impact totals.

**Project Lead actions:** When changes are requested, the PL sees the project in their Intake Queue with a 'changes_requested' badge. They can:
- **Accept Changes** — applies the controller's proposed forecast and resubmits for CC confirmation
- **Edit and Resubmit** — opens the forecast grid for the PL to make their own edits before resubmitting

sections.title: Approvals Tab
sections.body: Shows change requests that have passed CC Owner confirmation (Stage 2). Each row shows the project, CR summary, submitter, confirming CC Owner, and cost impact. Click to see full details including what changed, justification, and whether the change was system-suggested. Controllers can Approve, Reject, or Send Back.

sections.title: RAG Indicators
sections.body: Green means variance below 5%. Amber means 5-10%. Red means above 10%. The combined RAG takes the worst of budget RAG and timeline RAG. Hover over any RAG indicator to see the specific variance percentages.
